headline: The Google TV Streamer now costs $50 more
summary: Google's 4K streaming box price increased by $50 to $149. The new price is live on Google Store and Best Buy. Amazon still offers the original $99 price.

headline: JMGO’s very bright all-in-one projector looks ideal for gamers and sports
summary: JMGO's 4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max projector is now available globally. It boasts a 10,000:1 native contrast ratio using a dual-iris system. The projector is ideal for gamers and sports enthusiasts.

headline: FTC lawsuit alleges Amazon has been ‘secretly and systematically’ overcharging for ads
summary: The FTC and 22 states are suing Amazon over alleged 'secret ad surcharges.' This lawsuit claims Amazon artificially inflated ad prices on its platform. Higher ad costs were reportedly passed on to American consumers.

headline: I went to the loneliest baseball game on Apple Vision Pro
summary: An immersive MLB game was experienced on Apple Vision Pro for the first time. The virtual reality viewing was technically impressive and visually remarkable. Despite the tech, the experience felt somewhat nonsensical.

headline: Gal Gadot Says James Gunn and Peter Safran Told Her Wonder Woman 3 Was Happening Before Its Messy Cancellation
summary: Gal Gadot addressed the confusion surrounding Wonder Woman 3's cancellation. She confirmed James Gunn and Peter Safran initially said the film was happening. Gadot stated despite the 'messy' handling, she's 'all good' with them.

headline: IGN Australia and Chupa Chups Are Turning Westfield Parramatta Into a Retro Gaming Fun House This October
summary: IGN Australia and Chupa Chups are collaborating on an event. Westfield Parramatta will transform into a retro gaming fun house. The event is scheduled for October.

headline: The Blood of Dawnwalker PC Settings Guide: Maximize Your PC Performance By Tweaking These Options
summary: This guide helps PC gamers optimize 'The Blood of Dawnwalker.' It provides tips for tweaking settings to maximize performance. Improve your gaming experience with these crucial adjustments.

headline: Amazon Resale Has a Like New Nintendo Switch Pro Controller for Just $48.12 With Free Shipping
summary: A like-new Nintendo Switch Pro Controller is available on Amazon Resale. It's priced at $48.12 with free shipping. The controller is noted to be 'Switch 2 compatible.'

headline: Mel Stride and Priti Patel replaced in major Tory reshuffle
summary: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch initiated a significant reshuffle of her top team. Mel Stride and Priti Patel were replaced in the process. This shake-up precedes the party's October conference.

headline: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
summary: Rescuers are using explosives to reach trapped hydropower workers in Nepal. Families are anxiously awaiting news as efforts continue. The flooding death toll has reached 939.

headline: Messi retires from international football with 'nothing left to give'
summary: Lionel Messi announced his retirement from international football. He stated the decision 'hurt' but his time had come. The football great declared he had 'nothing left to give' his country.

headline: Hundreds remember Heaton Park synagogue attack victims at memorial event
summary: Hundreds attended a memorial event for victims of the Heaton Park synagogue attack. The event marks nearly a year since the incident. Speakers included the chief rabbi and Angela Rayner.
